req.title: Basic-auth requires both segments
req.statement: The system shall route /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> only when both user and passwd segments are provided.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must route only when BOTH path segments are provided. Tests must cover: (1) positive path with valid credentials matching both segments, (2) negative path with wrong credentials, (3) negative path with missing one segment (boundary), (4) missing auth header entirely, (5) correct user but wrong password, (6) correct password but wrong user. Each test asserts exact status codes and JSON payload fields to kill comparison-operator and boolean-logic mutations in check_basic_auth.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Both user and passwd path segments are provided
Authorization header matches the path segments exactly
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypass with correct Basic auth header
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='myuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-049: both segments provided, credentials match -> 200
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_authenticated_true():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/myuser/mypass',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'myuser'

test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_authenticated_true()

import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_response_payload_exact_fields():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/alice/secret',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'alice'

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_user_in_response_matches_path_not_header():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'bob:pass123').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/bob/pass123',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['user'] == 'bob'
    assert data['user'] != 'pass123'
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
